kind: DIRECTED — human-steered, not a protocol. EXTERNAL_LEDGER §17.
why_directed_is_allowed_here: Direction biases toward FINDING. That bias is disqualifying when establishing that a defect exists, and load-bearing when establishing that no prior work states it: a directed search that finds nothing is stronger evidence of absence than a blind protocol that finds nothing.
